title: Meet Google Cloud
summary: Google Cloud provides hosted services for computing, storage and data work. Begin by matching a service to a small, clear need.
introduction: Google Cloud provides hosted services for computing, storage and data work. Begin by matching a service to a small, clear need. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Google Cloud provides hosted services for computing, storage and data work. Begin by matching a service to a small, clear need.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: You need no Google Cloud account, card or keys to read these lessons. Examples are worked plans only. Real resource changes need separate permission and cost review.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of Google Cloud Platform. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.

blocks.code:
Need: store the files for a club page
Data: index.html, styles.css and logo.png
No need: visitor passwords or a custom database
blocks.title: Meet Google Cloud

blocks.text: The example is a static-file problem. Cloud hosting does not force the app to have a backend.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Separate static files from a feature that would need live server work.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Cloud experiments may have costs; no resources are created by these lessons.
For more detail later, use this [Google Cloud Platform further reading](https://cloud.google.com/docs/overview).
